_comment: The Overpass API servers live map data is fetched from, in the order they're tried. The one Overpass client (packages/osm/src/overpass.ts — CI's precache, the desktop's sidecar, the website's last rung) goes down the list until one answers; the desktop's "Test connection" tries them all at once and passes when one does (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/proxy.rs, which compiles this file in), so it tests what a live fetch would reach. Build time only, like ./cdn.json.
